chapter: Back in Houston, Club Ebony and Boo Pleasant
title: Taking over the Club Ebony in January 1960
summary: Back in Houston, Cobb and his wife take over management of Club Ebony around the corner from his house and use his band as house band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, when you get down here then, Arnett, what do you do then, when you get here?

I come into Houston in June, and I worked around, I formed a band here. But around the corner here [in the Curbette that was in,] the man had heard about me, by the name of Louis T. Nicholson is the name. So he says to everybody in the neighborhood wanting to know about me. People that had run the club for him, a man and his daddy, they had ripped him off for some money, but I didn't know this. So he asked me to take it.
So my wife and I took it over in January, 1960.
Club Ebony, right around the corner from this house here.
Took over the managership. And now -- I put my band in there as a house band. So I kept it in there six months.
